en-GB.codex_lore_a2m3_text:
▶  After more than a decade, I've finally found part of the accursed weapon crafted by Queen Maestra in the early days of the War.





● Myden tells me one half corrupts life, and the other, death. 

● There is already a soul bound to this weapon. Thank goodness we need not find another willing sacrifice - or worse.



▶  We will begin construction of a silent temple immediately. We must deter all from seeking this power until the end of time.

- Kinshiro the Troubled
en-GB.codex_lore_crystal_warriors_text:
Faahri Armed Forces
Research Division - CONFIDENTIAL
Subject: Experiment #29 Conclusion

- We assumed the lone survivor, #4, had killed the others. However, they were found in a protective position atop subject #2’s body. They did not appear to have taken part in the struggle that claimed the others’ lives.
- We were prepared to terminate #4; however, we determined that the subject could maintain perfect control and composure while in their transformed state. 
- In the future, it may be possible to select subjects that match #4’s composure; however, we recommend against repeating this particular experiment for the time being.

Summation: Against all odds, this was an extremely impressive showing. Please notify the Principal Researcher that the army is formally extending her a contract offer to develop further crystal technologies.
en-GB.codex_lore_crystal_warriors_text2:
Reply: Experiment Conclusion

Thank you for your notes on this matter.

Actions taken:
- We have notified the chosen researcher.
- We have disposed of #1 - 3.
- Unable to locate next-of-kin for #1 and #3. Their personal effects have been destroyed or donated.
- Personal effects for #2 have been relinquished to #4.
en-GB.codex_lore_desert_secrets_text:
▶  "Adventurers and businessmen traveling East have long been warned not to stray beyond the Quagmarsh. 

● Legends of a lost city in
the desert have abounded for centuries, but attempts to reach it have been blocked by a tempest.

● This ceaseless sandstorm has claimed the lives of all who dared enter - until now!

● Magus Archibald Everlye is the first to venture into the desert and live to tell the tale.



● According to Everlye, the lost city of legend does exist - but somehow, people still inhabit it! 

● Everlye was disappointed to be unable to loot the city's glittering buildings for artefacts, but he says there was one consolation:


  "They have very good fish."

● Upon Everlye's return to Cherrystone, the storm that has raged for centuries suddenly ceased altogether, exposing the lost city to the world once more.


● Its denizens call the city "Heavensong," and its government the Heavensong Dynasty. 

● Queen Myra V is expected to begin diplomacy and/or conquest of the region within the coming months.
en-GB.codex_lore_desert_secrets_title: Secrets of the Lost City Revealed!
en-GB.codex_lore_fahri_tale_text:
▶ ...But they'd eaten all the books!

● So every month, Mrs. Fahri went to the mountain's caves to read to the micefolk. 

● When they were too restless for stories, Mrs. Fahri showed them the stars.

● When she was too old to climb the mountains, the micefolk came to her instead.

● When she was laid to rest, the micefolk wept and wept. 

● Mrs. Fahri often said, “We must protect children of all kinds.”  

● Though the mice have forgotten this tale, we never forgotten our promise to their kind.

- The Tale of Nour al-Nujum Fahri, the Librarian

● Maybe Nuru right, and Sedge’s soldiers still hurting people in Sedge’s name...

● Firebird
Captain of the Artifice

Captain of the Good Fortune

en-GB.codex_lore_russom_note_text:
▶  Young Zawan,

● I hope you need never again venture here. 

● These ancient halls warn of a great evil sealed away - and I have now encountered this evil, in this very room. 

▶  The day you were healed here, she spoke to me... No, not spoke - screamed. Her voice clawed at my mind and threatened to consume it.

● The voice haunted me for many months after. I have just decided to rid the Forest of it once and for all.

▶  Whatever the nature of this evil, it is sealed in stone and crystal - and now lies at the bottom of the sea. Be wary of that awful song.

- Greenfinger Russom
en-GB.codex_lore_starglass_attack_text:
▶  "Following the recent attacks on the House of Knowledge, the Senate has voted to raise an armed forces for the first time
in Faahri history.

● Senator Quadratica explained the decision thusly: 
 

● 'We are not cutting ties with the humans of the foothills, nor are we denying the safety they've afforded the Republic in the past. 
 
● We are merely exploring our options for self-protection in this uncertain age.'
 
 
● The identity and provenance of the attackers is yet unknown."

- The Starglass Times

entombed here.

from this place. 
Such is the will of all

en-GB.codex_lore_worldsong_text:
▶  "The song that birthed the world has long since faded. Yet every drop of matter bears its remembrance."





▶  "Young mage - your power stems from distant echoes of the Worldsong singing in your soul." 

▶  "The splendour of the cosmos 
is all around us. We need only listen."



Contents:
▶ Preface: The Worldsong
  ● The Lifesong
  ● The Earthsong
  ● The Seasong
  ● The Heavensong
  ● The Deathsong
▶ Afterword: More songs to 
  discover?
